interface.signature: root: TreeNode, target: int, k: int -> List[int]

preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root of the tree is either a TreeNode or None.
The target node value is an integer between 1 and 10^4.
The distance k is an integer between 1 and 20.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value is a list of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**4 for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the return list is between 1 and 10^4.
The return list is sorted in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(x in get_nodes_at_distance_k(root, target, k) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the return list is at distance k from the target node.
